name: project-rules
description: Shoppershala project-specific CC Safety Net rules. Blocks destructive Docker, filesystem, and git operations.
author: project

rules.name: block-docker-destructive
rules.reason: Use 'docker compose down' without flags, or 'docker compose down --volumes' only after confirming data backup.

rules.name: block-rm-recursive-force
rules.reason: Use 'rm' on specific files only. For directory cleanup, verify contents first.

rules.name: block-chmod-recursive
rules.reason: Use targeted chmod on specific files. Recursive permission changes can break the project.

rules.name: block-git-force-push
rules.reason: Use 'git push' without --force. If force push is necessary, use '--force-with-lease' with explicit justification.
